title: Cambridge, MA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Cambridge, MA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Cambridge is a city in MA with a population of 118,000. Home of Harvard and MIT with a world-class innovation ecosystem and historic charm. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.5.
